canonical_deload.default_trigger: Every 4th week of a mesocycle (3 weeks load progression → 1 week deload).
canonical_deload.raw:
**Definition**: -40% volume, -10% load, hold technique. Same exercises as the prior week; sets dropped by ~40%; loads scaled back ~10%. Same template selection, same slot rules. Conditioning intensity reduced (Zone 2 only; no tempo/intervals).
**Default trigger**: Every 4th week of a mesocycle (3 weeks load progression → 1 week deload). Templates with their own deload signals (RPE >8 on Superset A for 3 sessions, etc.) trigger deload earlier and reset the mesocycle counter.
**Template-specific overrides**: If a Layer 1 template's Decision rules name a different deload behavior, that template's rule wins for that template's sessions. The canonical applies to the rest of the user's week.

macrocycle.raw:
**Standard 12-week macrocycle**: 3 mesocycles of 4 weeks each. Each mesocycle: wk1 MEV (minimum effective volume entry) → wk2 MAV (maximum adaptive volume mid) → wk3 MRV (maximum recoverable volume peak) → wk4 deload (canonical). Goal-specific macrocycle structures override (e.g., C-cluster race blocks follow event-week-counting periodization; F-cluster pregnancy phases follow gestational milestones; E-cluster rehab phases follow symptom-graduation criteria).
**Volume progression within mesocycle**: Sets scale wk1→wk3 per Layer 2 doctrine (MEV→MAV→MRV). Loads scale modestly (+5% per week if RPE held at target). Decision rules in Layer 1 templates intercept before MRV is reached if recovery markers deteriorate.
**Mesocycle entry rule**: A new mesocycle starts from the wk1 MEV baseline regardless of where the prior mesocycle ended. If the prior mesocycle's wk4 was a forced deload (decision-rule-triggered, not scheduled), the new mesocycle's wk1 may start at a reduced baseline (~85% of prior MEV) — Program Designer's call based on recovery markers.

frequency_defaults.raw: Reactivator Phase 1 entry, F1 Pregnancy T1, F3 Pregnancy late T3, F6 Senior fitness entry, maintenance phases of A4/D1. Default templates: Full Body OR Reactivator Phase 1 (2-day).
Most goal entry points outside specialist tracks. Default split: hinge-emphasis / squat-emphasis / upper-emphasis (or Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A as named templates).
Hypertrophy emphasis, strength-focused intermediate, hybrid Phase 2+. Default: Lower P / Upper PP / Lower A / Upper + Core (4-day split).
Performance-mode (Hyrox prep peak, race prep peak, B2 strength peak block). Splits depend on goal; conditioning sessions count toward the total.

conditioning_patterns.raw: **Polarized base (Seiler)**: ~80% Zone 2, ~20% threshold/VO2max. Default for off-season and base phases (C1/C2/C3/D2).
**Pyramidal (event-prep)**: ~70% Zone 2, ~20% tempo, ~10% intervals. Default for 8-12 weeks pre-event (C1, C2, C3, C5).

**Hyrox-specific (Mangine)**: 2-3 strength sessions/week + 2-3 conditioning sessions/week + 1 simulation/week in peak phase. Default for C4.
Layer 5 references these patterns; it does not redefine them. If new conditioning research is needed for a goal, flag to KB Editor in the next cycle — do not invent in Layer 5.

combo_session.raw: Combo session = single-pair strength compound (Superset A only) → ~20 min Zone 2 transition → strength finisher (Superset C only). ~60 min total. **Available templates**: Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2 Loaded (1×/week). **Eligible goals**: A5 Hybrid-in-comeback Phase 2, C4 Hybrid athlete Phase 2 reentry, B3 Strength endurance with hybrid context. **Not eligible**: trained-user goals without hybrid context, any rehab phase, any pregnancy phase.

special_weeks.behaviour: Maintenance only. No new stimulus. Mobility priority. Last hard session ≥4 days pre-event. Eligible: any C-cluster goal in peak/event-week. Eligible: G5 Stage prep — show week.
special_weeks.eligibility: Maintenance only. No new stimulus. Mobility priority. Last hard session ≥4 days pre-event. Eligible: any C-cluster goal in peak/event-week. Eligible: G5 Stage prep — show week.
special_weeks.raw: **Race week / event week**: Maintenance only. No new stimulus. Mobility priority. Last hard session ≥4 days pre-event. Eligible: any C-cluster goal in peak/event-week. Eligible: G5 Stage prep — show week.

special_weeks.behaviour: Canonical (-40% volume, -10% load) unless template specifies otherwise. Applied wk4 of standard macrocycle OR decision-rule-triggered.
special_weeks.eligibility: Canonical (-40% volume, -10% load) unless template specifies otherwise. Applied wk4 of standard macrocycle OR decision-rule-triggered.
special_weeks.raw: **Deload week**: Canonical (-40% volume, -10% load) unless template specifies otherwise. Applied wk4 of standard macrocycle OR decision-rule-triggered.

special_weeks.behaviour: MEV-only, mobility daily, no conditioning above Zone 2. Restart cycle wk1 MEV after recovery week.
special_weeks.eligibility: MEV-only, mobility daily, no conditioning above Zone 2. Restart cycle wk1 MEV after recovery week.
special_weeks.raw: **Recovery week (post-illness, life-event, travel disruption)**: MEV-only, mobility daily, no conditioning above Zone 2. Restart cycle wk1 MEV after recovery week.

special_weeks.behaviour: Drop to the prior phase's template for that week. Re-graduate via the phase's transition criterion before progressing again.
special_weeks.eligibility: Drop to the prior phase's template for that week. Re-graduate via the phase's transition criterion before progressing again.
special_weeks.raw: **Symptom-flare week (E-cluster rehab phases)**: Drop to the prior phase's template for that week. Re-graduate via the phase's transition criterion before progressing again.
